Both stored values are slightly high, and their exact sum falls midway between two doubles and rounds to the upper one
explanation: Every arithmetic step is correctly rounded — IEEE 754 requires it. The error entered when the decimal literals were converted to binary, before any addition happened. The exact sum lands precisely halfway between two representable doubles, and round-half-to-even picks the one whose last mantissa bit is 0.
